mechanism_narrative: A lower federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) reduces the discount rate applied to equity cash flows, leading to higher S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as capital becomes cheaper for corporate investment.
failure_condition: Rank IC for FEDFUNDS as a predictor of 20-day returns falls below 0.03 in any 3-year rolling window, or negative returns occur in >60% of low-rate periods.

mechanism_narrative: A rising unemployment rate (UNRATE > 5.0%) signals deteriorating labor market conditions, reducing consumer spending and corporate earnings, which leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5-day returns in >60% of instances when UNRATE exceeds 5.0%, or Rank IC for UNRATE is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous strength in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicates robust consumer demand, driving corporate revenue growth and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Interaction term between HOUST and RSAFS fails to predict 20-day returns with Rank IC >0.03 in any 3-year window, or joint signal yields positive returns <50% of the time.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp decline in industrial production (INDPRO) below 95% of its 3-month average signals a supply shock, reducing corporate output and profits, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in >60% of INDPRO decline events, or Rank IC for INDPRO as predictor is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Strong quarterly GDP growth (GDPC1) indicates a robust economy, supporting corporate earnings and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days (one quarter).
failure_condition: Rank IC for GDPC1 as predictor of 60-day returns is below 0.03 in any 3-year window, or 60-day returns are negative in >50% of strong GDP quarters.

mechanism_narrative: High inflation (CPIAUCSL > 2.5%) signals an overheating economy that may trigger aggressive monetary tightening, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in >60% of CPIAUCSL >2.5% instances, or Rank IC for CPIAUCSL is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Strong labor market growth (PAYEMS growth > 0.5% monthly) supports consumer spending and corporate profits, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20-day returns in >60% of PAYEMS growth >0.5% instances, or Rank IC for PAYEMS is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous increases in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) and inflation (CPIAUCSL) signal a tightening monetary policy cycle, compressing equity valuations and leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Interaction term between FEDFUNDS and CPIAUCSL fails to predict 20-day returns with Rank IC >0.03 in any 3-year window, or joint signal yields negative returns <50% of the time.
